article.story: NORTH ANDOVER, Mass. -- — Jayden Harris scored 26 points as UMass-Lowell beat Merrimack 71-61 on Thursday. Harris also added 11 rebounds for the River Hawks (2-0). Victor Okojie added 16 points while shooting 6 of 9 from the field and 4 for 6 from the line while they also had six rebounds. Jakai Newton had 12 points and shot 3 of 10 from the field and 6 of 8 from the free-throw line. Jeremiah Anderson finished with 18 points for the Warriors (0-2). Denver Anglin added 10 points and two steals for Merrimack. AJ Lesburt Jr. finished with seven points, two steals and two blocks. Up next Both teams play again on Sunday. UMass-Lowell hosts Marist and Merrimack travels to play Albany (NY). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
